Windows x64.

## Changes

- Improved wallpaper browsing responsiveness with queued thumbnail loading and loading indicators.
- Improved animated-preview loading, looping, and recovery from stalled playback.
- Improved live wallpapers by downloading higher-quality video and playing local video files.
- Improved maximizing, restoring, and dragging management and wallpaper windows across monitors, including taskbar clearance.

## Download

Single EXE for Windows x64 with .NET 10 included.
